Cigars & the ritual around them

AM issuePrices checked Sun Oct 18, 2026 (morning scan)

Boxes worth laying down, honest-value bundles, and well-made tools. Every comparison is against observed street price—not an ornamental MSRP.

Availability note. Fourteen desk entries were price-checked Sunday morning, October 18, 2026 (morning scan) across Famous Smoke Shop, CigarBid, Cigars Direct, and Gotham Cigars, plus named street-reference sources; all 14 are unique listings. Discounts use live street prices only. Five entries are CigarBid live auctions — the price shown is the current bid at check time, not a fixed price, bids exclude shipping, and bids may rise before the close times shown on each card. Seven cards ship without a photo because no confirmable product photo existed for those listings. Stock, sale windows, auction bids, shipping, and checkout totals may change after the check.

Collectible ≠ guaranteed return

The investment desk is an asking-price snapshot, not a resale forecast. Each listing names its comparison source and shows condition and completeness where the scan confirmed them.

Price integrityTwo eBay listings in this issue were checked live against street prices today: the Breitling Chronomat GMT 40 A32398101L1A1 (WatchMaxx, new with box and papers, $5,025 vs a $5,280 eBay street listing) and the Breitling Superocean 44 A17376211C1A1 (Reference In Time, new with box and papers, $3,320.25 vs $3,418 at WatchMaxx). The investment desk names its comparison basis on every card — Chrono24 dealer-listing medians for the Rolex Sky-Dweller 326933, the Audemars Piguet Royal Oak Offshore Diver 15701ST.OO.D002CA.01, and the Audemars Piguet Royal Oak Offshore Diver Scuba Boutique 15701ST.OO.D002CA.03 — and the desk’s two standing benchmark references are named in full wherever this check is cited: the Rolex Submariner Date 126610LN and the Rolex GMT-Master II 126710BLNR. Compare condition, seller type, completeness, shipping, and import costs before treating any asking-price gap as a deal.
LiquidityEstimate how broad the resale market is and how quickly similar pieces actually move.
CompletenessBox, papers, original parts and service records can matter disproportionately.
Ownership dragBuyer premium, tax, servicing, insurance and selling fees belong in the thesis.

Market data, not financial advice. No appreciation claims. Watches are illiquid collectibles; values can fall, provenance can be wrong, and servicing can erase an apparent discount.

03 / OPEN QUESTIONS

Verify before buying

Availability, auction bids, checkout pricing, seller terms, warranty coverage, exact condition, and expiring coupon terms can change after the AM scan.

Liquidity, defined. Each watch carries the Ledger's liquidity read — High: deep resale market, typically sells in days at market price; Good: active market, typically sells in weeks at a fair price; Thin: narrow buyer pool, longer to sell. It's an editorial assessment from comparable listings, price band, and condition — a guide to how fast you could get out, not a resale guarantee.
